releaseNotes:
1. Continuous Refresh Fixed: Fixed launcher window watchdog to support Chromium Aura architecture, preventing server termination and continuous reload loops.
2. Cloud & Local Image Library: Integrated Cloudinary product gallery with automatic local disk downloading and database persistence.
3. Two-Way Catalog Sync: Manual Sync with Cloud button in catalogue toolbar with latest timestamp (updated_at) conflict resolution on both sides.
4. Active/Inactive Product Status: Status toggle column and filters; inactive products automatically excluded from cashier billing view.
5. Standard Retail Barcode Scanning: Global keyboard wedge scanning directly adds scanned items to cart from any screen.
6. Live Digital Scale Auto-Weight: Automatic real-time weight sync from digital scale COM port to produce cart lines.
